$comment: B1.5b evaluation contract. Machine-readable tool schema fixture; the single source of truth for variants G0-G3. Production truth becomes the @Tool/@ToolParam generated schema, which must be verified identical by a consistency test. See docs/ai/README.md.
revised: 2026-11-09 (fact fix: ratings coverage starts 2001, not 2000; contract_version bumped v1 -> v2)
status: DRAFT - pending oracle review and user approval; not implemented in production code
schema_hash_algorithm: sha256 over json.dumps(tools, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8

db_snapshot.source: docker container fabflix-mysql (host port 3307), database moviedb
notes: genre enum MUST be derived from the database (SELECT DISTINCT name FROM genres ORDER BY name), never hand-written; the list below is only this snapshot
genre rows contain duplicate names Action/Comedy/Drama/Horror/Thriller (ids 1-23 and 9001-9006) - always DISTINCT
'Sci-Fi' has 457 movies while 'Science Fiction' has 2: canonicalization of this pair is a server-side alias decision, not an enum change
movie id is an opaque VARCHAR(10); only 9073 of 21087 rows start with 'tt' - never assume the prefix

ratings exist only for 2001-onwards titles (MIN(year) among rated movies = 2001; all 58 movies from 2000 and all 11,975 from 196-2000 have no rating row), so any pre-2001 rating filter is unsatisfiable and must return EMPTY_RESULT with coverage metadata

error_contract.INVALID_ARGUMENT: wrong type/syntax, missing required, unknown field, or value outside the enum
error_contract.OUT_OF_RANGE: syntactically valid number, but outside current data coverage (196-2024); server returns coverage{year_min,year_max}
error_contract.EMPTY_RESULT: valid and in-range query with zero matches; server returns coverage (including rating_coverage_from)

function.name: search_movies_by_title
function.description: Resolve a movie title to catalog rows. The catalog stores English original titles only; Chinese translated titles do not match. Use it to look up a title and to resolve a seed movie before calling find_similar_movies.

query.description: Title fragment as typed by the user, in the catalog's English original form.

year.description: Optional release year for disambiguation only. Omit unless the user stated a year.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Server default is 5 (3 when used for disambiguation).

function.name: filter_movies
function.description: Filter the catalog by genre, year range and/or minimum rating. At least one filter must be provided; sort and limit are not filters. Years outside 196-2024 return OUT_OF_RANGE, not an empty list.

year_from.description: Inclusive lower bound on release year.

year_to.description: Inclusive upper bound on release year.

min_rating.description: Inclusive minimum rating. Only pass when the user asked for one; ratings exist for 2001-onwards titles only (no 2000-or-earlier title has a rating row).

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Server default is 5.

function.name: find_similar_movies
function.description: Given a catalog movie id, return movies sharing catalog signals (genres, same/close year, same director, shared top-3 stars). Cannot use plot or style similarity: the catalog has no synopsis.

movie_id.description: Catalog movie id obtained from search_movies_by_title. Never invent it.

same_primary_genre_only.description: If true, results must share the seed movie's primary genre, defined as the alphabetically first of the seed's genre names.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Server default is 5.

function.name: recommend_movies
function.description: Recommend catalog movies from explicit user preferences (genre, year range, minimum rating, director, seed movies). At least one preference is required. This is content-based recommendation, not personalized history.

min_rating.description: Inclusive minimum rating. Only pass when the user asked for one.

director.description: Director name exactly as stored in the catalog (Latin script).

seed_movie_ids.description: Catalog movie ids used as positive seeds.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Server default is 5.

function.name: get_movie_card
function.description: Return the full card of a single catalog movie by id (title, year, director, genres, top-3 stars, rating).

movie_id.description: Catalog movie id from a previous tool result. Never invent it.
